steps.label: graph-nodes
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Nodes(id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: graph-edges
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Edges(src INT64 NOT NULL,dst INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(src,dst)

steps.label: graph-ordinary
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH G NODE TABLES(Nodes LABEL Node) EDGE TABLES(Edges SOURCE KEY(src) REFERENCES Nodes(id) DESTINATION KEY(dst) REFERENCES Nodes(id) LABEL Edge)

steps.label: path-TRAIL-{0}
steps.sql: GRAPH G MATCH TRAIL (a)-[e]->{0}(b) RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS src,b.id AS dst ORDER BY src,dst

steps.label: path-TRAIL-{0,1}

steps.label: graph-reused-label
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH SameLabel NODE TABLES(Nodes LABEL Shared) EDGE TABLES(Edges SOURCE KEY(src) REFERENCES Nodes(id) DESTINATION KEY(dst) REFERENCES Nodes(id) LABEL Shared)

steps.label: graph-reused-label-read
steps.sql: GRAPH SameLabel MATCH (a:Shared)-[e:Shared]->(b:Shared) RETURN a.id AS src,b.id AS dst ORDER BY src,dst
